close_reason: Deferred: get_or_try_init is nightly-only so a static TokioResolver requires a panic-on-init pattern or a Mutex<Option<...>>. Cache misses are rare once warm; the overhead is acceptable. Revisit when std::sync::OnceLock::get_or_try_init stabilizes.
description: mta_sts_dns.rs:22-24 calls TokioResolver::builder_tokio().build() on every lookup_mta_sts_txt invocation. Resolver construction opens UDP sockets and reads /etc/resolv.conf. Even though MtaStsEnforcer caches policies, each cache miss creates a new resolver. Expected impact: O(n) resolver instantiation per cold domain; at startup with many new domains this adds measurable latency. Fix: hold a TokioResolver in MtaStsEnforcer and pass it as a parameter to lookup_mta_sts_txt, or make it a lazy static.
title: New TokioResolver constructed on every MTA-STS DNS lookup
